svg.title: Insurance case study: AI-assisted delivery improved policy servicing and customer-query resolution
svg.desc: An anonymous large insurer used AI-assisted engineering, a policy knowledge assistant, and advisor workflow automation. Working outcomes are 90 percent better policy-servicing query resolution, 50 percent less manual query resolution, and 40 percent improvement in delivery cycles.
svg.text: Faster policy servicing, from code to customer answer
AI-assisted engineering and trusted policy knowledge connected delivery speed to service quality
Teams reconstructed logic before improving service
Registration work competed for delivery capacity
AI-assisted engineering clarified workflows and sped up change
A knowledge assistant supported consistent customer answers
Registration workflows moved from manual steps to repeatable flow
SERVICE QUALITY HELD IN THE FLOW
Policy-grounded answers with human handoff and release review
ONE DELIVERY SYSTEM ACROSS FOUR OPERATING SURFACES
The insurer improved delivery and customer service together by making policy knowledge reusable
